entries.9535fb276c058e2a: Based on its basic mission of "contributing to society through town development," the company formulated the "Long-Term Management Plan 2030," looking ahead to 2030, in January 2020. Aiming to "maximize business opportunities to deliver greater value to a wide range of customers" and to "transform into a portfolio that is highly efficient and resilient to market changes, as required of a listed company," the company states that it will steadily advance large-scale domestic development pipelines centered on Marunouchi, while focusing overseas business on developed countries, mainly in the Americas, Europe and Australia. In addition, the company states that it will make the expansion of non-asset businesses and entry into the service and content domains new pillars of growth for the entire company. In the Marunouchi Business, the company states that it will advance rebuilding, renovation and soft development under the "Marunouchi NEXT Stage Strategy," and promote "platformization of the entire town" under the "Marunouchi 'Whole Town Workplace' Concept."
